notes.title: Demo Version 0.2 Update
notes.content: [p]Fixed bugs and made minor changes based on the received feedback. Further adjustments received through the feedback form and related to improving the gameplay will be implemented in future updates.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with automatic language detection based on the system language[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where all tavern visitors would leave after refusing the goblin's takeaway order[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred for some users[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the inventory[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3893050/Long_Live_My_Lady__Tavern_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with automatic language detection based on the system language
Fixed a bug where all tavern visitors would leave after refusing the goblin's takeaway order
Fixed a crash that occurred for some users
